name: Shockwave ring
summary: Rings that expand out from an impact point with a fading stroke; for hits, landings and punchlines.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: len
params.note: frames for one ring to finish

params.name: color
params.note: ring colour; default the style accent

author: krakujs
